# nobus_lbaas_provision (Resource)

Provisions a load balancer and its nested listeners/pools in one API call. payload_json follows LoadBalancerProvisionSchema.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nobus_lbaas_provision" "example" {
  payload_json = jsonencode({
    name              = "production-edge"
    project_id        = var.nobus_project_id
    availability_zone = "nobus-wa-az1"
    flavor            = "small"
    listeners = [{
      name          = "http"
      protocol      = "HTTP"
      protocol_port = 80
    }]
    pools = []
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `payload_json` (String)

### Read-Only

- `availability_zone` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `project_id` (String)
- `state` (String)
- `task_id` (String)
